task: Provide a recipe for vegetarian lasagna with more than 100 reviews and a rating of at least 4.5 stars suitable for 6 people.
final_answer:
## Recipe Found: Easy Vegetarian Spinach Lasagna

I found a vegetarian lasagna recipe on Allrecipes that meets all your criteria. Here are the details:

### Recipe Overview
- **Title:** Easy Vegetarian Spinach Lasagna
- **URL:** https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/229764/easy-vegetarian-spinach-lasagna/
- **Rating:** 4.6 out of 5 stars ✓ (exceeds 4.5 minimum)
- **Ratings Count:** 117 ✓ (exceeds 100 reviews)
- **Servings:** 6 ✓ (exactly matches your requirement)
- **Submitted by:** MOTTSBELA
- **Prep Time:** 20 mins | **Cook Time:** 1 hr | **Total Time:** 1 hr 25 mins

### Description
Satisfying layers of stretchy melted mozzarella, creamy ricotta, and spinach combine with sauce-coated lasagna noodles for the ultimate comfort food.

### Ingredients
- Cooking spray
- Salt and ground black pepper to taste
- 10 ounces fresh spinach
- 9 lasagna noodles
- 1 (8 ounce) container ricotta cheese
- 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese, divided
- 1 large egg, lightly beaten
- 1 pinch ground nutmeg
- 1 pinch dried basil
- 1 cup pasta sauce
- ¼ cup grated Parmesan cheese

### Directions
1. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Spray a 1½-quart casserole dish with cooking spray.
2. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Place spinach in the water and boil until wilted and tender, about 2 minutes. Remove spinach with a slotted spoon, pressing out excess water. Set aside.
3. Cook lasagna noodles in the same boiling water, stirring occasionally, about 8 minutes. Drain.
4. Mix spinach, ricotta cheese, ½ cup shredded mozzarella, egg, nutmeg, basil, salt, and black pepper in a bowl.
5. Spread ¼ cup pasta sauce on the bottom of the dish. Layer 3 noodles, half the ricotta mixture, and ¼ cup sauce. Repeat layers. End with remaining 3 noodles and ¼ cup sauce. Top with remaining ½ cup mozzarella and Parmesan. Cover with foil.
6. Bake covered for 25 minutes. Uncover and bake another 25 minutes until bubbling and browned. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

### Nutrition (per serving)
305 calories | 10g fat | 37g carbs | 18g protein

This was the best match among the candidates. Other high-rated vegetarian lasagnas I checked (like the Vegetarian Four Cheese Lasagna with 243 ratings) didn't qualify because they serve 8 instead of 6.

final_answer:
I successfully found and documented a popular chocolate chip cookie recipe from Allrecipes.com. Here are the complete details:

## 🍪 Best Chocolate Chip Cookies
**Source:** https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/10813/best-chocolate-chip-cookies/
**Popularity:** 19,463 ratings • **Yield:** 48 servings

### Ingredients
| Quantity | Ingredient |
|----------|------------|
| 1 cup | butter, softened |
| 1 cup | white sugar |
| 1 cup | packed brown sugar |
| 2 | large eggs |
| 2 teaspoons | vanilla extract |
| 1 teaspoon | baking soda |
| 2 teaspoons | hot water |
| ½ teaspoon | salt |
| 3 cups | all-purpose flour |
| 2 cups | semisweet chocolate chips |
| 1 cup | chopped walnuts (optional) |

### Preparation Steps (Directions)
1. **Gather your ingredients** — Make sure your butter is softened and your eggs are at room temperature.
2. **Preheat the oven** to 350°F (175°C). Lightly grease the baking sheets.
3. **Cream the butter and sugars** — Beat the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar with an electric mixer in a large bowl until smooth and creamy (1–2 minutes). Beat in the eggs and vanilla extract until combined. Dissolve the baking soda in the hot water; add to the batter along with the salt, and mix until combined.
4. **Add the dry ingredients** — Stir in the flour, chocolate chips, and walnuts until a soft dough forms.
5. **Portion the dough** — Drop rounded spoonfuls of cookie dough about 2 inches apart onto the ungreased baking sheets.
6. **Bake** in the preheated oven until the edges are lightly browned, about **10 minutes**.
7. **Cool** on the baking sheets briefly before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely. Store in an airtight container or serve immediately.

### Notes
- This is the highest-rated chocolate chip cookie recipe on Allrecipes.com with nearly 20,000 ratings.
- A serving-size adjuster (½×, 1×, 2×) is available on the original page.
- Walnuts are optional and can be omitted or substituted.

I found a perfect match for the requested cookie recipe on Allrecipes:

## Recipe: Best Chocolate Chip Cookies

- **Rating:** ⭐ 4.6 stars (meets the 4.5+ requirement)
- **Total Ratings:** 19,463
- **Reviews:** 14,905 (well over the 1000 minimum)
- **Recipe URL:** https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/10813/best-chocolate-chip-cookies/
- **Yield:** 4 dozen cookies (48 servings)
- **Prep Time:** 20 mins | **Cook Time:** 10 mins | **Total Time:** 30 mins

### Ingredients:
1. 1 cup butter, softened
2. 1 cup white sugar
3. 1 cup packed brown sugar
4. 2 large eggs
5. 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
6. 1 teaspoon baking soda
7. 2 teaspoons hot water
8. ½ teaspoon salt
9. 3 cups all-purpose flour

**Source:** https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/140772/easy-microwave-chocolate-cake/

### ✅ Criteria Met:
- **Prep Time:** 5 minutes (less than 30 minutes ✓)
- **Contains Chocolate:** Yes — uses cocoa powder ✓

### 📝 Description
"This microwave chocolate cake is quick and easy to make and cooks in the microwave in 2 minutes. And it tastes great, really! The consistency is dense and cakey. It would go well with chocolate (or your favorite) chips or nuts or served warm with hot fudge. This cake, 'born' out of a pregnancy craving, worked out amazingly." — Submitted by Laura

### 🥣 Ingredients
1. Nonstick cooking spray
2. ¼ cup white sugar
3. ¼ cup milk
4. 1 large egg
5. 3 tablespoons butter, softened
6. 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
7. ½ cup all-purpose flour
8. **2 tablespoons cocoa powder** (the chocolate ingredient)
9. ¼ teaspoon baking powder
10. 1 pinch salt

**Yield:** 2 servings

### 👨‍🍳 Step-by-Step Instructions

1. **Prep the bowl:** Spray a medium microwave-safe bowl with nonstick cooking spray; set aside.

2. **Mix the batter:** Combine sugar, milk, egg, butter, and vanilla in a mixing bowl; mix well. Combine flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt in a separate bowl. Blend the flour mixture into the milk mixture until smooth. Pour into the prepared microwave-safe bowl.

3. **Microwave:** Cover and cook in the microwave on high until the cake springs back when touched, 2 to 2½ minutes. Allow the cake to cool for 5 minutes, then cover the bowl with a plate and invert the cake onto the plate.

---

**Bonus Info:**
- Cook Time: 2 mins
- Total Time: 7 mins
- Per serving: 433 calories, 21g fat, 54g carbs, 9g protein

final_answer:
# Indian Chicken Curry (Murgh Kari) — Allrecipes

## Recipe Snapshot
- **Title:** Indian Chicken Curry (Murgh Kari)
- **Rating:** ★ 4.7 (out of 5)
- **Reviews:** 1,012 written reviews (1,291 total ratings) — well above the 30-review threshold
- **Source:** https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/212721/indian-chicken-curry-murgh-kari/
- **Author / Updated by:** Ayshren; updated September 11, 2026 (tested by the Allrecipes Test Kitchen)
- **Servings:** 6

## Preparation & Cooking Time
- **Prep Time:** 20 minutes
- **Cook Time:** 40 minutes
- **Total Time:** 1 hour

## Ingredients (1× serving = 6)
1. 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
2. 2 teaspoons salt
3. 3 tablespoons cooking oil, or as needed
4. 1½ cups chopped onion
5. 1 tablespoon minced garlic
6. 1½ teaspoons minced fresh ginger root
7. 1 tablespoon curry powder
8. 1 teaspoon ground cumin
9. 1 teaspoon ground turmeric
10. 1 teaspoon ground coriander
11. 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
12. 1 tablespoon water
13. 1 (15 ounce) can crushed tomatoes
14. 1 cup plain yogurt
15. 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro
16. 1 teaspoon salt
17. ½ cup water
18. 1 teaspoon garam masala
19. 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro
20. 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice

## Cooking Instructions
1. **Gather all ingredients.**
2. **Season and brown the chicken:** Sprinkle the chicken breasts with 2 teaspoons salt. Heat 1–2 tablespoons oil in a large skillet over high heat. Brown chicken in batches (adding more oil as needed) until partially cooked and golden on all sides. Transfer browned chicken to a plate and set aside.
3. **Sauté aromatics:** Reduce heat to medium. Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the oil left in the skillet. Cook and stir until the onion is soft and translucent, 5–8 minutes. Stir in curry powder, cumin, turmeric, coriander, cayenne, and 1 tablespoon of water; cook together about 1 minute, stirring constantly.
4. **Build the sauce:** Add the crushed tomatoes, yogurt, 1 tablespoon chopped cilantro, and 1 teaspoon salt; stir to combine.
5. **Simmer the curry:** Return the chicken breasts (with any juices on the plate) to the skillet. Pour in ½ cup water and bring to a boil, turning the chicken to coat in the sauce. Sprinkle the garam masala and 1 tablespoon cilantro over the chicken.
6. **Finish cooking:** Cover and simmer until the chicken is no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 20 minutes (an instant-read thermometer should read at least 165 °F / 74 °C).
7. **Serve:** Drizzle with fresh lemon juice and enjoy.

### Recipe Notes / Tips
- Boneless chicken thighs can be substituted for chicken breasts.
- Coconut milk can replace the yogurt if preferred.
- Leftovers keep in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days — reheat gently over low heat.

## Brief Introduction to The Allrecipes Allstars

I successfully navigated to the Allrecipes website and found the introduction to The Allrecipes Allstars on the Allrecipes community section (linked from the "About Us" area). Here is what Allrecipes says about the Allstars:

**Page Title:** *Meet the Allrecipes Allstars: Brand Ambassadors to the World's Largest Food Community* (by Ansley Emmet)

### Introduction to The Allrecipes Allstars:

> **"The Allrecipes Allstars are the voice of our community.** This group of 70+ passionate home cooks and content creators from across the country knows what works in the kitchen—because they cook every day, just like you. Since 2011, they've shared trusted recipes and practical tips with the more than 60 million people who visit Allrecipes each month.
>
> These 10 Allstars offer a snapshot of our community, showcasing its diversity in talent, locations, and cooking styles. Together with the rest of the Allstars, they've developed and photographed 7,000+ recipes, and have left an additional 41,000+ reviews across recipes on our site."

### Key Highlights:
- **Role:** Brand ambassadors and the voice of the Allrecipes community
- **Size:** A group of 70+ passionate home cooks and content creators from across the United States
- **Established:** Since 2011
- **Audience:** More than 60 million people visit Allrecipes each month
- **Featured spotlight:** 10 Allstars showcased at a time, representing the community's diversity in talent, locations, and cooking styles
- **Contributions:** Together they've developed and photographed 7,000+ recipes and left over 41,000+ reviews

The page then introduces individual Allstars such as Lindsey Close (Denver-based food creator), Ramona Cruz-Peters (Texas-based mom and cookbook author), and Shelley Fang (Dallas-based content creator behind @salty_shelley), among others.

**Source:** https://www.allrecipes.com/allstars-8661275

## 🚗 Product Found

**Step2 Whisper Ride II Kids Push Car**
- **Rating**: ⭐ 4.6 out of 5 stars
- **Total Reviews**: 16,620 (well over 100)
- **Features**: Ride-On Car with Seat Belt and Horn, Quick Fold Handle, Stroller Alternative, Toddlers and Preschoolers Ages 18+ Months, Blue

## 📝 Top Review

**Review Title**: "Another driver coming up"
**Reviewer**: Praise The Lord, Always (Verified Purchase)
**Date Reviewed**: October 17, 2013 (in the United States)
**Rating Given**: 4 stars
**Helpful Votes**: 30 people found this review helpful

**Review Body**:
> "First the 'downside': The parts lists shows item K, but, this is NOT a part, only a tool (of which I didn't use) and it had part P, stuck inside, of which, I wasted time trying to figure out how to use it. The answer came when it fell on the floor and part P came loose (an extra part for locking the wheel on the shaft). I used a rubber mallet, not hammer, and a ratchet screwdriver with a good handle, which made putting the 'dashboard' easier to put on as there isn't any pre-drilled holes to start the screws and also the screws for the seat belts (the belts are on backwards on this car?) are very long and would be difficult to screw in using a normal screwdriver, especially if one has trouble using their hands...
>

final_answer:
I have successfully searched Amazon for portable air conditioners suitable for a 300 sq ft room with energy efficiency rating. Here are the top 3 search results comparison:

## Search Summary
- **Search Query**: "portable air conditioner 300 sq ft energy efficient"
- **Total Results**: 927 results found
- **Sort**: Featured (default)

## Top 3 Search Results - Price Comparison

| Rank | Product | Price | BTU (ASHRAE/DOE) | Rating | Room Coverage |
|------|---------|-------|------------------|--------|---------------|
| 🥇 **#1** | **DREO Portable Air Conditioner 318S** | **$367.10** (Limited time deal, -17% off; List: $439.99) | 8,000 / 5,000 | 4.2★ (1,328 reviews) | Best fit for 300 sq ft |
| 🥈 **#2** | **DREO Portable Air Conditioner 516S** | **$599.99** | 14,000 / 10,000 | 4.1★ (736 reviews) | Overkill for 300 sq ft (~550-700 sq ft) |
| 🥉 **#3** | **DREO Portable Air Conditioner 319S** | **$399.49** (Limited time deal, -15% off; List: $469.99) | 10,000 / 6,000 | 4.2★ (1,328 reviews) | Good for 300+ sq ft (~350-400 sq ft) |

## Price Comparison (Low → High)
1. **DREO 318S**: $367.10  *Best Value & Best Fit*
2. **DREO 319S**: $399.49
3. **DREO 516S**: $599.99

## Energy Efficiency Analysis
All three products are certified energy-efficient portable ACs with DOE (Department of Energy) BTU ratings:
- **DREO 318S**: 5,000 BTU DOE – lowest energy consumption, **best efficiency for 300 sq ft rooms**
- **DREO 319S**: 6,000 BTU DOE – moderate efficiency
- **DREO 516S**: 10,000 BTU DOE – highest capacity (but uses more power)

## 💡 Recommendation
For a **300 sq ft room**, the **DREO 318S** is the optimal choice:
- ✅ **Best price** at $367.10 (with current 17% discount)
- ✅ **Perfectly sized** (8,000 BTU ASHRAE) for 300 sq ft – no overcooling waste
- ✅ **Lowest energy consumption** of the three
- ✅ Highest customer rating (4.2★ with 1,328 reviews)

The Amazon search page also showed useful filters including "Floor Area: 299 to 399 ft²" (which encompasses your 300 sq ft requirement) and "Sustainability Features: Energy Efficiency" filter to help narrow down products.

# MacBook Air Price Comparison (Latest Models with M5 Chip)

Based on Apple's website (apple.com/shop/buy-mac/macbook-air), the latest MacBook Air models are powered by the **M5 chip** and come in two sizes:

## 📊 Price Comparison

| Model | Starting Price | Monthly Payment | Difference |
|-------|---------------|-----------------|------------|
| **13-inch MacBook Air (M5)** | **$1,299** | $108.25/mo for 12 mo. | — |
| **15-inch MacBook Air (M5)** | **$1,499** | $124.91/mo for 12 mo. | +$200 |

## ⚙️ Shared Configuration (Base)

Both models come standard with the **M5 chip** featuring:
- **10-core CPU, 8-core GPU, 16-core Neural Engine**
- Upgradable to **10-core CPU, 10-core GPU, 16-core Neural Engine** (for more graphics-intensive tasks)

## 🎨 Customization Options (Both Models)

- **Unified Memory:** 16GB, 24GB, or 32GB
- **SSD Storage:** 512GB up to 4TB
- **Power Adapter:** 3 options available

## 🔑 Key Takeaway

The **15-inch model costs $200 more** than the 13-inch model at base configuration. Both feature the same M5 chip, Liquid Retina display technology, and identical customization options — the price difference is purely for the larger screen size. Apple also offers lease options starting from $24.99/mo (13-inch) or $28.99/mo (15-inch) for 36 months with Apple Upgrade.

task: Research the new features of the iOS 17 on Apple support and check its compatibility with the iPhone 12.
final_answer:
I have completed my research on iOS 17 features from Apple Support. Here's my comprehensive answer:

## iOS 17 Research Summary

**Source:** Apple Support - About iOS 17 Updates (https://support.apple.com/en-us/118723)

### Major New Features in iOS 17

**📞 Phone**
- **Contact Posters** - Customize how you appear on other people's devices when you call
- **Live Voicemail** - See a live transcription as someone leaves a message and pick up the call *(iPhone 12 and later)*

**💬 Messages**
- **Stickers iMessage app** - All your stickers in one place (Live Stickers, Memoji, Animoji, emoji stickers, third-party packs)
- **Live Stickers** - Create stickers by lifting subjects from photos/videos with effects like Shiny, Puffy, Comic, Outline
- **Check In** - Automatically notifies a family member or friend when you arrive at a destination safely *(iPhone 12 and later)*
- **Audio message transcription** - Read audio messages in the moment, listen later

**📹 FaceTime**
- Leave a video or audio message
- FaceTime calls on Apple TV *(iPhone 12 and later)*
- Reactions (3D effects like hearts, balloons)
- Video effects to adjust Portrait mode intensity

**🔋 StandBy**
- Full-screen experience with glanceable information when iPhone is on its side while charging
- Various clock styles
- Photos automatically shuffle through your best shots
- Widgets at a distance

**Additional Categories** (per Apple Support): AirDrop with NameDrop for contact sharing, Keyboard improvements, Safari updates (Profiles, Tab Groups, Private browsing, Passkeys), Passwords & Password AutoFill, Music (SharePlay, Favorites, Apple Music Sing), AirPlay (In-car, hotel room TVs), AirPods (Adaptive Audio, Personalized Volume, Conversational Awareness), Maps (Offline maps), Siri updates, Visual Look Up, Translate with camera, Health (Mental wellbeing, Mood), and Accessibility features (Personal Voice, Live Speech, Point and Speak).

---

### ✅ iPhone 12 Compatibility with iOS 17

**Yes, the iPhone 12 IS fully compatible with iOS 17.**

iOS 17 supports iPhone XR, iPhone XS, iPhone XS Max, iPhone 11 series, **iPhone 12 mini/iPhone 12/iPhone 12 Pro/iPhone 12 Pro Max**, and later models.

**Features specifically requiring iPhone 12 and later:**
- Live Voicemail
- Check In
- FaceTime calls on Apple TV
- StandBy (Note: StandBy is also restricted on iPhone XR/XS due to Always-On Display requirements; iPhone 12 supports it fully)

**Exceptions for iPhone 12:**
- **Adaptive Audio, Personalized Volume, Conversational Awareness** (AirPods features) - require AirPods Pro (2nd generation), not the iPhone model
- **Crash Detection optimizations** - require iPhone 14 and later

The iPhone 12 supports the vast majority of iOS 17 features, with the noted exceptions being device-specific hardware limitations rather than software compatibility issues.

task: Compare the prices and chips for the iPhone 14 Pro and iPhone 15 Pro models directly from Apple's website.
final_answer:
I have completed the task by comparing the iPhone 14 Pro and iPhone 15 Pro from Apple's website. Here is the comparison:

## iPhone 14 Pro vs iPhone 15 Pro — Comparison from Apple.com

| Feature | iPhone 14 Pro | iPhone 15 Pro |
|---|---|---|
| **Chip** | A16 Bionic chip | A17 Pro chip |
| **Price** | Available at authorized resellers | Available at authorized resellers |

### Key Findings:

**Chips:**
- **iPhone 14 Pro** is powered by the **A16 Bionic chip** (6-core CPU, 5-core GPU, 16-core Neural Engine)
- **iPhone 15 Pro** is powered by the **A17 Pro chip** (6-core CPU, 6-core GPU, 16-core Neural Engine, plus hardware-accelerated ray tracing — an upgrade from the iPhone 14 Pro)

**Prices:**
- Neither the iPhone 14 Pro nor the iPhone 15 Pro is currently sold directly on Apple's website. Both models are listed as **"Available at authorized resellers"** — meaning Apple has discontinued direct sales of these older Pro models (they are now only available through third-party retailers).
- The current iPhone lineup on Apple's website features newer models like the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 17 Pro, iPhone Air, and iPhone 16 Pro.

### Summary:
The most notable difference between these two models is the **chip upgrade** from the A16 Bionic to the A17 Pro (which introduced hardware-accelerated ray tracing and an extra GPU core). Both phones were originally priced starting at $999 when launched, but their current purchase price must be obtained through authorized resellers since Apple no longer sells them directly.

Source: [Apple iPhone Compare page](https://www.apple.com/iphone/compare/?modelList=iphone-14-pro,iphone-15-pro,iphone-18-pro) (captured 2026-09-17)

final_answer:
Based on my research of Apple's archived website (November 2023, when the M3 Max MacBook Pro 16-inch was actively sold), here are the details:

**MacBook Pro 16-inch Configuration:**
- Apple M3 Max chip with 16-core CPU and 40-core GPU
- 64GB Unified Memory
- 1TB SSD Storage

**Price: $4,199.00**

**Breakdown:**
- Base configuration (16-core CPU / 40-core GPU / **48GB** Unified Memory / 1TB SSD) = **$3,999.00**
- CTO upgrade from 48GB to **64GB** Unified Memory = **+$200.00**
- **Total: $4,199.00**

**Note:** The MacBook Pro 16-inch with the M3 Max chip is no longer sold on Apple.com (it has been replaced by M4 Pro/M4 Max and now M5 Pro/M5 Max models). The price information above comes from an archived version of the Apple website from November 8, 2023.

final_answer:
# Latest iPad Model Specifications

Based on my navigation through apple.com, the **latest iPad model** released by Apple is the **iPad Pro (M5)**, available in two sizes. Here are its detailed specifications:

## Models
- **iPad Pro 11-inch (M5)**
- **iPad Pro 13-inch (M5)**

## Storage Options (Capacity)
Both the 11-inch and 13-inch models are available in:
- **256GB**
- **512GB**
- **1TB**
- **2TB**

## Processor Type
- **Apple M5 chip**
  - 9-core CPU with 3 super cores and 6 efficiency cores (on 256GB / 512GB models)
  - 10-core GPU with Neural Accelerators
  - Hardware-accelerated ray tracing
  - 16-core Neural Engine

## Display Features
**11-inch model:**
- Ultra Retina XDR display
- Tandem OLED
- 2420-by-1668-pixel resolution at 264 ppi
- ProMotion technology with adaptive refresh rates from 10Hz to 120Hz
- Wide color (P3)
- True Tone
- Fingerprint-resistant oleophobic coating
- Fully laminated
- Antireflective coating
- Nano-texture display glass option on 1TB and 2TB models
- SDR brightness: 1000 nits max
- XDR brightness: 1000 nits max full screen, 1600 nits peak (HDR content only)
- 1 nit minimum brightness
- 2,000,000:1 contrast ratio
- Supports Apple Pencil Pro, Apple Pencil (USB-C), and Apple Pencil hover

**13-inch model:**
- Ultra Retina XDR display
- Tandem OLED
- 2752-by-2064-pixel resolution at 264 ppi
- ProMotion technology with adaptive refresh rates from 10Hz to 120Hz
- Wide color (P3)
- True Tone
- Fingerprint-resistant oleophobic coating
- Fully laminated
- Antireflective coating
- Same brightness/contrast specs as the 11-inch model
- Supports Apple Pencil Pro, Apple Pencil (USB-C), and Apple Pencil hover

## Source
Information retrieved from: **https://www.apple.com/ipad-pro/specs/**

## Latest MacBook Model — Apple.com Findings

Based on my research of apple.com, I found information on **two notable MacBook models** that are currently featured:

### 🆕 MacBook Neo (Newest MacBook Line)
This is the newest addition to the MacBook family, positioned as an entry-level option. Source: https://www.apple.com/macbook-neo/specs/

- **Model Name:** MacBook Neo 13-inch
- **Processor:** Apple A18 Pro chip
  - 6-core CPU (2 performance cores + 4 efficiency cores)
  - 5-core GPU with hardware-accelerated ray tracing
  - 16-core Neural Engine
  - 60GB/s memory bandwidth
  - Media Engine with hardware-accelerated H.264, HEVC, ProRes, and ProRes RAW
- **Memory:** 8GB unified memory
- **Storage:** 256GB SSD or 512GB SSD
- **Display:** 13.0-inch Liquid Retina display (2408-by-1506 native resolution at 219 pixels per inch, 500 nits brightness)
- **Finishes:** Silver, Blush, Citrus, Indigo
- **Pricing:** Starts at $699 (or $599 with education savings)

### 💻 MacBook Pro (Latest Flagship)
The flagship MacBook has been updated with the new M5 family of chips. Source: https://www.apple.com/macbook-pro/

- **Processor Options:** M5, M5 Pro, or M5 Max
- **Pricing:** Starting at $1,999

---

**Summary:** If interpreting "latest MacBook model" as the newest MacBook line introduced, it is the **MacBook Neo with A18 Pro chip, 8GB unified memory, and 256GB/512GB SSD storage**. If interpreting as the latest MacBook flagship, it is the **MacBook Pro with the new M5/M5 Pro/M5 Max chip family**.

final_answer:
## Latest iPad Model on Apple.com

Based on my browsing of Apple's official website (apple.com/ipad-pro and apple.com/ipad-pro/specs), the latest iPad model Apple is selling is the **iPad Pro with the M5 chip** (available in 11-inch and 13-inch sizes).

| Specification | Detail |
|---|---|
| **Model Name** | iPad Pro (M5 chip) — available in 11-inch and 13-inch |
| **Release / Availability Date** | October 22, 2025 (the product page displayed "Available 10.22"; Tech Specs footnotes reference preproduction testing "in August and September 2025," consistent with an October 2025 launch) |
| **Base Storage Capacity** | 256 GB (also available: 512 GB, 1 TB, 2 TB) |
| **Starting Price** | **From $1,199** (or $99.91/month for 12 mo.) |

**Source quotes from apple.com:**
- Capacity section (Tech Specs): *"iPad Pro 11‑inch 256GB 512GB 1TB 2TB / iPad Pro 13‑inch 256GB 512GB 1TB 2TB"*
- Chip section (Tech Specs): *"Apple M5 chip — Models with 256GB or 512GB storage: 9-core CPU…"*
- iPad Pro overview page headline/price: *"From $1199 or $99.91/mo. for 12 mo."*

Note: The release date of October 22, 2025 was indicated on the iPad Pro product page banner; the "10.22" string was visible in the live page but not captured in a retrievable text span in the cached observation, so that specific wording is corroborated by the Aug–Sept 2025 preproduction testing footnote rather than a literal quoted date in saved memory.

task: What Apple Repair ways are mentioned on apple website, answer 2 of them.
final_answer:
## Task Completed Successfully

I navigated to Apple's Repair page at **support.apple.com/repair** and found the following Apple Repair ways mentioned. I'll provide 2 of them as requested:

### Two Apple Repair Ways:

**1. Apple Retail Stores**
- Apple retail stores offer Apple-certified repairs using genuine Apple parts. Repairs performed directly by Apple are covered by Apple's Limited Warranty and AppleCare plans.

**2. Self Service Repair**
- Self Service Repair is intended for individuals with the knowledge and experience to repair electronic devices. It provides access to genuine Apple parts, tools, and repair manuals to perform your own out-of-warranty repair.

---

**Additional repair ways also mentioned on the page (for reference):**
- **Apple Authorized Service Providers** – A large network of certified providers offering Apple-certified repairs using genuine Apple parts.
- **Independent, non-authorized repair providers** – Have access to genuine Apple parts and repair resources, but do not provide Apple-authorized repairs covered by Apple's Limited Warranty or AppleCare.

Source: Apple Service and Repair page (https://support.apple.com/repair)

final_answer:
## Task Complete ✅

I navigated to the archived Apple website page for the **MacBook Pro 14-inch with M3 chip** (since the M3 model is no longer sold on Apple's current shop page, which now features M5 chips, I used a Wayback Machine capture from the period when M3 was Apple's current offering).

### Base Model (Cheapest)
- **Model**: MacBook Pro 14-inch with M3 chip — Space Gray
- **Specs**: 8-core CPU, 10-core GPU, 8GB unified memory, 512GB SSD storage, 70W USB-C Power Adapter
- **Base Price**: **$1,599.00**

### Available Hardware Upgrade Options

| Category | Upgrade Option | Price |
|---|---|---|
| **Memory** | 16GB unified memory | +$200.00 |
| **Memory** | 24GB unified memory | +$400.00 |
| **Storage** | 1TB SSD storage | +$200.00 |
| **Storage** | 2TB SSD storage | +$600.00 |
| **Power Adapter** | 96W USB-C Power Adapter | +$20.00 |

(Pre-Installed Software such as Final Cut Pro +$299.99 and Logic Pro +$199.99 were excluded per the task instructions.)

### Maximum Upgrade (No Pre-Installed Software)
- **24GB unified memory**: +$400.00
- **2TB SSD storage**: +$600.00
- **96W USB-C Power Adapter**: +$20.00

### Price Calculation
- **Base price**: $1,599.00
- **Total upgrades**: $400 + $600 + $20 = **$1,020.00**
- **Maximum upgraded price**: $1,599.00 + $1,020.00 = **$2,619.00**
- **Total price difference (base → max upgrade)**: **$1,020.00**

task: Find on Apple website how many types of AirPods (3rd generation) are available and what is the price difference.
final_answer:
## Final Answer

Based on my research of the Apple website, here's what I found about AirPods (3rd generation):

### Number of Types: **2 types**

According to Apple's AirPods Compare page (https://www.apple.com/airpods/compare/), there are **2 types** of AirPods (3rd generation) listed:

1. **AirPods (3rd generation) with Lightning Charging Case**
2. **AirPods (3rd generation) with MagSafe Charging Case**

### Price Difference: **Not currently available on the Apple website**

I was **unable to find the price difference** between the two types on Apple's website because:

- The shop pages for both AirPods (3rd generation) variants return "Page Not Found" (e.g., `/shop/buy-airpods/airpods-3rd-generation/lightning-charging-case` and `/shop/buy-airpods/airpods-3rd-generation/magsafe-charging-case`)
- Searching Apple.com for "AirPods 3" or "AirPods 3rd generation" returns **no results** for these products (only AirPods 5, AirPods Pro 3, and AirPods Max 2)

task: Check if there are trade-in offers for the latest model of iPhone.
final_answer:
## Answer

**Yes, apple.com currently advertises trade-in offers that apply to the latest iPhone model.**

### Latest iPhone Models
According to apple.com/iphone, the newest iPhone models (both marked "New") are:
- **iPhone Duo** (featured first in the lineup, starting at $1,999 — described as "The thinnest iPhone we've ever made")
- **iPhone 18 Pro** (starting at $1,199)

### Trade-In Offers
Apple's Trade In program (apple.com/shop/trade-in) offers trade-in credit that can be **applied toward a qualifying new device purchase**, including the latest iPhones. Key points:

- **Top iPhone trade-in values** (credit toward new iPhone Duo / iPhone 18 Pro):
  - iPhone 17 Pro Max: Up to **$885**
  - iPhone 17 Pro: Up to **$785**
  - iPhone Air: Up to **$585**
  - iPhone 17: Up to **$585**
  - iPhone 16 Pro Max: Up to **$610**
  - iPhone 16 Pro: Up to **$510**
  - iPhone 16 Plus / iPhone 16: Up to **$430**
  - And additional values going back to older models (iPhone 8 Plus: Up to $35, iPhone SE 2nd gen: Up to $40, etc.)

- **Important note**: The newest models (iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro) are not listed as devices with trade-in *values* — because they're the newest. However, the program explicitly states: *"Trade-in value may be applied toward qualifying new device purchase, or added to an Apple Gift Card."* So customers can trade in any older eligible iPhone and use the credit to reduce the cost of the new iPhone Duo or iPhone 18 Pro.

- **Eligibility requires** being at least the age of majority, with trade-in values varying based on condition, year, and configuration.

## Task Result: Unable to Complete — Product Discontinued

I was unable to retrieve a price for the **Apple iPhone 14 Plus (256GB, Purple)** because this product is **no longer available for sale on apple.com**.

### What I Found

1. **Direct buy page returns "Page Not Found"**: Navigating to `https://www.apple.com/shop/buy-iphone/iphone-14-plus` produces an Apple "Page Not Found" error (the page reads: *"The page you're looking for can't be found."*).

2. **Not in the current iPhone lineup**: The `/shop/buy-iphone` page lists only the current lineup — iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro / 18 Pro Max, iPhone Air, iPhone 17, iPhone 17e, and iPhone 16. The iPhone 14 Plus is not among them.

3. **Not in the Refurbished store**: The `/shop/refurbished/iphone` store only offers iPhone 15 series, iPhone 16 series, iPhone 16e, and iPhone 18 series. The iPhone 14 Plus is not available even refurbished.

4. **Site search yields no buy page**: Searching apple.com for "iPhone 14 Plus" returns results only about newer iPhone models and a few support/battery test references — no live product listing with pricing.

### Conclusion

Apple has **discontinued sales of the iPhone 14 Plus** through its online store. Because no product page exists for this SKU on apple.com, there is no current Apple-listed price for the 256GB Purple variant. To obtain a price, you would need to check third-party retailers (e.g., Amazon, Best Buy, carrier stores) or the used/refurbished market.

task: Check the storage options and prices for the latest iPad Pro models on Apple's website.
final_answer:
## iPad Pro Storage Options and Prices (Latest Model)

Based on the current Apple website (apple.com/shop/buy-ipad/ipad-pro), the latest iPad Pro is powered by the **M5 chip** and is offered in two sizes — **11-inch** and **13-inch** — each with four storage tiers. Both models come in Space Black or Silver finishes.

### 🖥️ 11-inch iPad Pro (M5) — *starting from $1,199*

| Storage | Memory | Chip Configuration | Price |
|---------|--------|--------------------|-------|
| 256GB   | 12GB   | M5 (9-core CPU, 10-core GPU) | **$1,199** |
| 512GB   | 12GB   | M5 (9-core CPU, 10-core GPU) | **$1,399** |
| 1TB     | 16GB   | M5 (10-core CPU, 10-core GPU) | **$1,799** |
| 2TB     | 16GB   | M5 (10-core CPU, 10-core GPU) | **$2,299** |

### 🖥️ 13-inch iPad Pro (M5) — *starting from $1,499*

| Storage | Memory | Chip Configuration | Price |
|---------|--------|--------------------|-------|
| 256GB   | 12GB   | M5 (9-core CPU, 10-core GPU) | **$1,499** |
| 512GB   | 12GB   | M5 (9-core CPU, 10-core GPU) | **$1,699** |
| 1TB     | 16GB   | M5 (10-core CPU, 10-core GPU) | **$2,099** |
| 2TB     | 16GB   | M5 (10-core CPU, 10-core GPU) | **$2,599** |

### Notes
- **Step-up pricing within a model:** $200 between storage tiers up to 1TB, then $400 between 1TB and 2TB (e.g., 256→512GB +$200, 512GB→1TB +$400, 1TB→2TB +$500).
- **Step-up pricing between models:** The 13-inch costs exactly **$300 more** than the 11-inch at any given storage tier.
- All prices can also be financed at approximately $99.91–$216.58/mo for 12 months, or leased for 36 months from $24.99–$53.74/mo.
- Storage tiers of 256GB and 512GB ship with **12GB RAM** and the standard 9-core CPU M5, while 1TB and 2TB tiers upgrade to **16GB RAM** and the full 10-core CPU M5.

Source: apple.com/shop/buy-ipad/ipad-pro (captured September 17, 2026).

task: Identify the size and weight for the Apple TV 4K and list the Siri Remote features introduced.
final_answer:
Coverage is complete. Based on the data collected from Apple's website (https://www.apple.com/apple-tv-4k/specs/), here is the requested information:

## Apple TV 4K — Size and Weight

**Dimensions:**
- **Height:** 1.2 inches (31 mm)
- **Width:** 3.66 inches (93 mm)
- **Depth:** 3.66 inches (93 mm)

**Weight:**
- **Wi-Fi model:** 7.3 ounces (208 g)
- **Wi-Fi + Ethernet model:** 7.5 ounces (214 g)

## Siri Remote — Features Introduced

**Connectivity & Power:**
- **Bluetooth 5.0** wireless technology
- **IR transmitter**
- **USB-C connector** for charging
- **Rechargeable battery** providing months of battery life on a single charge (with typical daily usage)
- Charging via USB-C cable to computer system or power adapter (each sold separately)
- **Control your TV or receiver via IR or CEC**

**Siri Remote Buttons:**
- Microphone for Siri
- Touch-enabled clickpad
- Back
- Play/Pause
- Mute
- Power
- Siri
- TV/Home
- Volume
- USB-C

**Siri Remote Size and Weight:**
- Height: 5.4 inches (136 mm)
- Width: 1.4 inches (35 mm)
- Depth: 0.36 inch (9.25 mm)
- Weight: 2.3 ounces (66 g)

task: How many types of Apple Pencil are currently available on the Apple's website? Which one supports Wireless pairing and charging.
final_answer:
## Answer

**Number of Apple Pencil types available:** **2**

Based on the Apple Pencil features comparison section on Apple's website (https://www.apple.com/apple-pencil/), the two currently available Apple Pencil models are:

1. **Apple Pencil Pro**
2. **Apple Pencil (USB‑C)**

**Which one supports Wireless pairing and charging:** **Apple Pencil Pro**

According to the comparison table on Apple's site, the "Wireless pairing and charging" feature — which "Automatically pairs and charges when attached" — is:
- ✅ **Compatible with Apple Pencil Pro**
- ❌ **Not compatible with Apple Pencil (USB‑C)**
